claims.text: Kirkuk–Haifa pipeline built 1932–34 by the Iraq Petroleum Company; oil at Haifa 14 Oct 1934; 27 million barrels in 1935; 'strategically important' to the British Government; Haifa refinery from 29 Nov 1939, shut 12 Apr 1948.
Dead Sea concession granted in principle to Novomeysky and Tulloch, Dec 1927; leasehold; profits shared with the Palestine and Transjordan governments.
Hevrat ha-Ovdim founded 1923 as the Histadrut's economic arm.
Second World War: 10% Jewish unemployment at first; boom from 1942 as industry supplied the British army; about 30,000 Jews of Palestine enlisted.
The acetone 'reward' explanation of the Balfour Declaration appeared in Lloyd George's memoirs (1933); listed by historians as one explanation among several, all 'subject to debate'.
